contentList.content: The first time you coat a foe in <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ACID">Acid</LSTag> each combat, you summon an <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_MUTACID_ACIDSPAWN_INFO">Acid Spawn</LSTag> that fights on its own. On each of its turns it offers you two mutations; if you choose neither, it takes one of them on its next turn. Enough mutations make it grow into a larger slime. Its mutations stay with it between fights, and every fight it lives through brings it closer to starting the next one already grown. The brood dissolves when combat ends.
